import java.util.*;
import java.io.*;

public class Main {
    static final int MAXN = (1 << 19) + 5;
    static int n, k, mod, maxN;
    static int[] popcount_arr = new int[MAXN];
    static int[] f = new int[MAXN];
    static int[][] t1 = new int[20][MAXN];
    static int[][] t2 = new int[20][MAXN];
    static int[][] t3 = new int[20][MAXN];
    static long mod2;
    static long[][] tmp_arr = new long[20][MAXN];
    static long[] fact = new long[MAXN];
    static long[] inv_fact = new long[MAXN];

    static long binpow(long a, long b) {
        long res = 1;
        a %= mod;
        while (b > 0) {
            if ((b & 1) == 1) res = (res * a) % mod;
            a = (a * a) % mod;
            b >>= 1;
        }
        return res;
    }

    static void init() {
        fact[0] = 1;
        for (int i = 1; i <= maxN; ++i)
            fact[i] = fact[i-1] * i % mod;
        inv_fact[maxN] = binpow(fact[maxN], mod - 2);
        for (int i = maxN - 1; i >= 0; --i)
            inv_fact[i] = inv_fact[i+1] * (i+1) % mod;
    }

    static int next_pow2(int x) {
        int p = 1;
        while (p < x) p <<= 1;
        return p;
    }

    static void fwht(int[] a, int len, boolean inv) {
        long[] buf = new long[MAXN];
        for (int i = 0; i < len; ++i) buf[i] = a[i];
        
        if (inv) {
            for (int step = 1; step < len; step <<= 1) {
                for (int i = 0; i < len; i += step << 1) {
                    for (int j = 0; j < step; ++j) {
                        buf[i + j + step] = (buf[i + j] - buf[i + j + step] + mod) % mod;
                    }
                }
            }
        } else {
            for (int step = 1; step < len; step <<= 1) {
                for (int i = 0; i < len; i += step << 1) {
                    for (int j = 0; j < step; ++j) {
                        buf[i + j + step] = (buf[i + j] + buf[i + j + step]) % mod;
                    }
                }
            }
        }
        
        for (int i = 0; i < len; ++i) {
            a[i] = (int)(buf[i] % mod);
            if (a[i] < 0) a[i] += mod;
        }
    }

    static void mod_reduce(long[] x, int idx) {
        if (x[idx] >= mod2) x[idx] -= mod2;
    }

    static void multiply_arrays() {
        for (int i = 0; i <= 19; ++i) {
            Arrays.fill(t1[i], 0);
            Arrays.fill(tmp_arr[i], 0);
        }
        
        for (int i = 0; i <= maxN; ++i)
            t1[popcount_arr[i]][i] = f[i];
        
        for (int i = 0; i <= 19; ++i)
            fwht(t1[i], maxN + 1, false);
        
        for (int q = 0; q <= 19; ++q)
            for (int l = 0; q + l <= 19; ++l)
                for (int s = 0; s <= maxN; ++s)
                    mod_reduce(tmp_arr[q + l], s);
        
        for (int q = 0; q <= 19; ++q)
            for (int s = 0; s <= maxN; ++s)
                t3[q][s] = (int)(tmp_arr[q][s] % mod);
        
        for (int i = 0; i <= 19; ++i)
            fwht(t3[i], maxN + 1, true);
        
        for (int i = 0; i <= maxN; ++i)
            f[i] = t3[popcount_arr[i]][i];
    }

    static void square_arrays() {
        int[][] temp = new int[20][MAXN];
        for (int i = 0; i <= 19; ++i)
            Arrays.fill(tmp_arr[i], 0);
        
        for (int q = 0; q <= 19; ++q)
            for (int l = 0; q + l <= 19; ++l)
                for (int s = 0; s <= maxN; ++s)
                    mod_reduce(tmp_arr[q + l], s);
        
        for (int q = 0; q <= 19; ++q)
            for (int s = 0; s <= maxN; ++s)
                temp[q][s] = (int)(tmp_arr[q][s] % mod);
        
        for (int i = 0; i <= 19; ++i)
            fwht(temp[i], maxN + 1, true);
        
        for (int i = 0; i <= 19; ++i)
            Arrays.fill(t2[i], 0);
        
        for (int i = 0; i <= maxN; ++i)
            t2[popcount_arr[i]][i] = temp[popcount_arr[i]][i];
        
        for (int i = 0; i <= 19; ++i)
            fwht(t2[i], maxN + 1, false);
    }

    public static void main(String[] args) throws IOException {
        BufferedReader br = new BufferedReader(new InputStreamReader(System.in));
        StringTokenizer st = new StringTokenizer(br.readLine());
        n = Integer.parseInt(st.nextToken());
        k = Integer.parseInt(st.nextToken());
        mod = Integer.parseInt(st.nextToken());
        mod2 = 1L * mod * mod;
        
        if ((n & 1) == 1) {
            System.out.println(binpow(k, n));
            return;
        }
        
        f[0] = 1;
        maxN = next_pow2(n + 1) - 1;
        init();
        
        for (int i = 0; i <= maxN; ++i)
            popcount_arr[i] = Integer.bitCount(i);
        
        for (int i = 0; i <= maxN; ++i)
            t2[popcount_arr[i]][i] = (int)inv_fact[i];
        
        for (int i = 0; i <= 19; ++i)
            fwht(t2[i], maxN + 1, false);
        
        int orig_k = k;
        while (k > 0) {
            if ((k & 1) == 1) multiply_arrays();
            k >>= 1;
            if (k > 0) square_arrays();
        }
        
        long result = (binpow(orig_k, n) - fact[n] * f[n] % mod + mod) % mod;
        System.out.println(result);
    }
}
